item.title: NewYork-Presbyterian Nurses Reject Contract By Overwhelming Margin
item.description: NewYork-Presbyterian nurses rejected a tentative agreement by an overwhelming margin Wednesday, voting to extend their strike — now 31 days running — against the hospital system. Their union, the New York State Nurses Association, said the unfair labor practice strike and bargaining will continue.
